hypotheses.reasoning: At 19:20:51 order-service reloaded its config from config-service (revision 479), which changed PAYMENT_SVC_URL to port 9090. From 19:21:42 on, every payment call fails with ECONNREFUSED on 10.40.42.188:9090. payment-svc itself logs no errors, so it is up but not listening on that port. The gateway 503s that follow are downstream of this. The earlier card-processor connection reset (#108) and the slow audit_log query (#253) are one-off noise.
One card processor connection reset at 19:11, which retried. It is isolated and happened 10 minutes before the outage started.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back config-service revision 479 so PAYMENT_SVC_URL points at payment-svc's correct port again, and reload the config on order-service. Add validation or a canary check for endpoint config changes.
